|errata_history=The June 2017 source prints a lower cutout marked <code>E</code>, with power 2, ability 2, deploy 2, forfeit 3, a pilot icon and blank sensitivity box. The cover instructs using it with the original physical card. The original upper metadata remains uncovered: [[File:ANH-D-DS-61-4-Decipher-uncovered-upper.png|frameless|300px]]. The same game-text words already appear in the 1998 Decipher Glossary, PDF page 52: [[File:ANH-D-DS-61-4-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p52-entry.png|frameless|300px]]. This documents a source-image chronology, not a new gameplay-change claim. Actual partial: [[File:ANH-D-DS-61-4-June-2017-partial.png|frameless|300px]].

* The third stat-band box is blank. No named Force-sensitivity label is invented for ability 2; sensitivity is defined by ability (Advanced Rulebook 2023, PDF page 78).
* Black 4 supplies the squadron designation referenced by the piloting text. Squadron designation is a separate rules classification (Advanced Rulebook 2023, PDF page 91), not an extra entry in the formal Character-characteristics list.
* Destiny 2 and the literal lore are inherited from the original upper face, as instructed by the cover; they are not printed on the lower slip.<ref name="uncovered-original">[[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Decipher Errata]], cover instructions and PDF page 3; actual original [[:File:ANH-D-ds614-decipher-archive.gif]].
